item.title: Drone from Belarus crashes in Lithuania - The Maltese Herald
item.description: A large drone from Belarus crashed in Lithuania in the Varėna district near the village of Lavysas last Monday morning. Lithuanian press reports state that that the Lithuanian Army activated its emergency response and the Lithuanian Prime Minister called an emergency meeting of the National Security Commission.
